sentences.3.2 Jeg kommer ikke på norskkurs i dag: 3.2 I'm not coming to the Norwegian course today
sentences.I dag er Yousef hjemme, for Ismail er sy: Today Yousef is at home, because Ismail is ill.
Ismail is lying in bed asleep.
Yousef cooks and does the housework.
He tidies the house and vacuums the floor.
She comes home at two o'clock.
The phone rings, and Yousef answers.
sentences.Hei, Yousef! Det er Håvard. Du er ikke p: Hi, Yousef! It's Håvard. You're not at school today. Are you ill?
sentences.Nei. Jeg er hjemme, for Ismail er syk, o: No. I'm at home, because Ismail is ill and Leyla is working.
sentences.Jeg skal sende SMS til deg neste gang, H: I'll send you a text next time, Håvard.
sentences.Det er bra. Skal Leyla jobbe i morgen og: That's good. Is Leyla working tomorrow too?
sentences.Ja, men Ismail er kanskje frisk i morgen: Yes, but maybe Ismail will be well tomorrow.
sentences.Det håper jeg. God bedring til ham!: I hope so. Tell him I hope he gets better soon!
sentences.Tusen takk. Vi ses!: Thank you so much. See you!
sentences.Jeg kommer ikke på skolen i dag, for Ism: I'm not coming to school today, because Ismail is ill.
